summary: Crocs, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing Q2 2026 results and a $1.5 billion increase to its existing share repurchase authorization, leaving approximately $2.0 billion available. The board authorized the increase on July 30, 2026; repurchases may occur in open market or private transactions at company discretion, subject to market conditions, liquidity, and debt restrictions. No expiration date or obligation to acquire shares. The press release also raised full-year 2026 outlook. What to watch: pace of buybacks and potential EPS accretion, impact on leverage, and management comments on capital allocation.
